title: Other Things I Build
carving-content: I transform old hardcover books into hidden compartments or interactive objects. Each piece is designed around both the original material and the destination.
board-content: I draw inspiration from universes or objects that appeal to me to design small board games. I seek to translate these inspirations into fun game mechanics that remain consistent with the source material.
marbles-content: I build handcrafted mazes and interactive pieces using  marbles I kept from childhood. A way to turn forgotten objects back into something playful and interactive.
